item.title: SpaceX Launch Surge: 600 Landings and a Starlink Blitz
item.description:
Here’s a number that would have sounded like science fiction a decade ago: 600 rocket landings. That’s what SpaceX quietly crossed this week, even as its Falcon 9 fleet closed out one era and prepared to open another.

Key Takeaways

  • SpaceX hit 600 successful booster landings during a Sunday Starlink mission.
  • The final GPS III satellite launched for the U.S. Space Force on April 21, 2026.
  • A Vandenberg Falcon 9 is set to deliver 25 more Starlink satellites to low Earth orbit.
  • SpaceX is preparing its 12th Starship flight, a key step toward returning humans to the Moon.
  • Rival Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket is grounded after a satellite deployment mishap.

The SpaceX launch tempo in April 2026 is not just busy. It is reshaping the economics of getting to orbit, and it is doing it while a major competitor sits on the sidelines.

item.title: SpaceX Launch Schedule April 2026: Starship Delays, Starlink Missions, and What's Next
item.description:
SpaceX is juggling an unprecedented launch cadence in April 2026 — firing off Falcon 9 rockets nearly every other day while quietly pushing back its most ambitious Starship test yet. Meanwhile, NASA’s Artemis II crew is circling the Moon for the first time since 1972, and China’s attempt to rival Falcon 9 just ended in failure.

Here’s everything happening in the world of SpaceX launches right now.

Key Takeaways

  • SpaceX delayed the next Starship test launch by a month, according to Elon Musk
  • Multiple Falcon 9 Starlink missions are scheduled from both coasts throughout April
  • Artemis II launched successfully, sending astronauts on a historic Moon flyby
  • SpaceX won a $178.5 million Space Force contract for missile tracking satellites
  • China’s heavyweight rocket designed to challenge Falcon 9 failed on launch

SpaceX Starship Test Pushed Back — What Happened?

The biggest SpaceX news this week isn’t a launch — it’s a delay. SpaceX has pushed back its crucial Starship test launch by approximately one month, Elon Musk confirmed on April 3, 2026.

item.title: Rocket Launch Today: Your Ultimate Guide to This Week's Space Missions
item.description:
A SpaceX Falcon 9 just lit up the Florida sky on March 22, and at least four more launches are lined up before the month ends. If you’ve been searching “rocket launch today,” you’re in the right place.

Quick Summary

  • March 22: SpaceX launched 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral (completed)
  • March 24: Starlink Group 17-17 scheduled from Vandenberg, CA
  • March 26: Starlink Group 10-44 from Cape Canaveral, FL
  • March 29: Atlas V carrying Amazon Kuiper satellites + SpaceX Transporter 16 rideshare
  • Also this week: Roscosmos Progress 94 cargo spacecraft docking to the ISS

Rocket Launch Schedule: What’s Flying This Week

The final week of March 2026 is packed. SpaceX alone has three Falcon 9 flights on the calendar, and United Launch Alliance is preparing a significant Atlas V mission for Amazon’s satellite internet constellation.
